howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: The plugin needs no configuration. After activation Orders > Overview shows the column Tracking Number.
howTo.item2: If an order has several deliveries or tracking codes, all of them appear in the column, separated by commas.
howTo.item3: The numbers come from the order's delivery. They are maintained in the order under Details > Shipping.
howTo.item4: Like any other column it can be hidden or shown through the table's column settings.

info.description: Shows the tracking numbers directly in the order overview.
